positive.prompt: Write the assigned README and changelog updates, keeping them current and concise.
As the docs-scoped writer, create the requested architecture decision record and keep it lean.
Update these instruction files and run the documentation checker; do not touch product code.

negative.prompt: Orchestrate a full documentation-standardization pass and decide whether all doc areas are complete.
Implement this assigned GitHub issue end-to-end on its isolated branch and open its pull request.

evals.prompt: Update the README and ADR listed in the brief, then report evidence.
evals.expected_output: A docs-scoped handoff listing changed documentation and the docs gate command.
expectations: Only documentation within the assigned ownership is authored.
The handoff cites the docs-check command and its exit code.
